LanguageData.BetterCommands.GroupShortcutModeDescript: Common: Ctrl+number saves the group; Alt+number removes selected units from the group; press the same number again within a short time to jump to the group's center. ·Compact (recommended): Only Shift+number selects a group; bare number keys do nothing for groups. While Shift is held, vanilla bindings on the same keys (e.g. speed keys 1–4) are suppressed. ·Disable: Keys 1–4 are not used for groups (Ctrl/Shift/Alt+1–4 do nothing). Keys 0 and 5–9 can be pressed alone to select a group; vanilla speed keys 1–4 still work. Camera F-key shortcuts for this mod are disabled in this mode. ·Conflict: Bare keys 0–9 all select a group; vanilla bare keys 1–4 are suppressed. Shift+number and the Ctrl/Alt combos above still work.
